purpose: Three composites retaining the chosen N1 walnut kernel

variants.label: N1A / Walnut + blueberry
variants.prompt:
Use case: compositing / logo-brand.
Input image 1: the edit target and authoritative BetterFlash walnut-kernel logo. Preserve this exact walnut design as the dominant recognizable element: its two lobed brain-like halves, rounded silhouette, central groove, warm golden-brown colors, ivory outline and cartoon editorial drawing style. This is still clearly a walnut kernel.
Additional input images: supporting visual references for the explicitly requested food additions, not replacement logos.
Task: create ONE refined composite food logo according to the variant direction below. Integrate the additions into a single compact, optically balanced emblem. Keep the walnut visually dominant and its brain-like upper contour and central groove unobscured. Modest uniform scaling or repositioning within the emblem area is allowed to fit the additions; do not redraw the walnut as another shape.
Preserve the square specimen composition, plain dark aubergine background, exact ivory monospace wordmark "BetterFlash", its position and clear gap below the emblem. Replace the upper-left specimen caption with the exact caption specified below, in the same small ivory monospace style. Keep all artwork above the wordmark and comfortably within the original logo area.
Polish: modern, professional, educational, somewhat cartoonish, bold and readable, rounded contours, few large tonal shapes, consistent ivory outer keyline. Flat vector-like rendering suited to eventual small application icons.
Avoid: literal human brains, faces, eyes, mouths, limbs, hats, pointed crowns, sharp triangular silhouettes, text inside the emblem, extra food items, extra berries or leaves, scattered objects, table scenes, sparkles, shadows, glow, 3D, texture, gradients, mockups, watermarks or nutrition claims. No changes to the brand name.
Caption (verbatim): "N1A / Walnut + blueberry".
Variant: Image 2 is the blueberry reference. Add exactly ONE plump blueberry, about 35 percent of the walnut's width, nestled against and slightly overlapping the walnut's lower-left edge. Use the referenced blueberry's natural indigo-blue fill and rounded botanical calyx, simplifying only very small details to match the walnut. Its overlap covers only a small lower lobe, preserving both upper walnut hemispheres and the main groove. Keep the berry a clearly secondary accent and the overall silhouette compact and grounded. No spinach leaf or other leaf in this variant.
